messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up: tonight's midnight change window 23:45-00:30 UTC. Goal: promote v2026-03-21-1 to prod-eu. Need roll owner + emergency-unpin owner. Canary plan and smoke link please.
Jon Park: I'll own rollforward. Thresholds: p95 > 800ms for 5m OR error rate > 1% triggers hold/rollback.
DeployBot: [deploy-bot] Canary scheduled: env=prod-eu, version=v2026-03-21-1, canary=8%, start=00:12 UTC. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/2026-03-21-1.
Marco Li: I'll take emergency-unpin. Unpin script on standby: /scripts/unpin-prod-eu.sh. Reaction :white_check_mark:
QA-Bot: Smoke pipeline kicked: https://ci.redwood/pipe/12345. Quick checks: ping OK, basic generation output within tolerance.
Sara Lo: Release notes posted: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-21-1/notes. Note: no DB/schema migrations in this window.
Priya Nair: Observability link: https://grafana/redwood/d/prod-eu-rollouts. Please add queue depth + token backlog panels. Freeze reminder: no infra changes or secret rotates from 23:30-00:40 UTC.
Jon Park: Canary started at 00:12. Logs: https://logs.redwood/streams/3303021111. Current metrics: errors 0.12%, p95 420ms.
Marco Li: Standby for unpin. One-liner to unpin (approved):
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood/api/v1/unpin -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d 'env=prod-eu&reason=canary_spike&owner=Marco'
```
Priya Nair: Roll guidance: prefer rollforward to v2026-03-20-stable unless there's corruption or user-data loss risk. Jon you have final push authority; escalate infra to @Marco if nodes need intervention.
Jon Park: Got it. Adding guard: pause full rollout until p95 < 700ms for 10m continuous.
DeployBot: Canary ramp to 30% at 00:25 UTC. Monitoring... status: nominal.
Sara Lo: Quick checklist for release: 1) release notes link, 2) QA smoke green, 3) dashboards green, 4) ops oncall present. Reply 'affirm' to proceed.
Marco Li: affirm
Jon Park: affirm
Priya Nair: Proceeding to ramp schedule: full ramp at 00:35 if no thresholds hit. Keep this channel for minute-by-minute updates.
DeployBot: Ramp paused at 70% at 00:36 UTC due to queue-depth spike alert. Notify owners.
Jon Park: investigating shard imbalance (queue depth spike). ETA 4m. If error rate also rises call unpin.
Marco Li: I'm staged to run unpin; will execute on Jon's call.
QA-Bot: rerunning targeted smoke tests on affected shard.
